title: CIA congressional budget reprogramming and appropriations-oversight cluster (1965-1988)
ordinary_explanation: Routine appropriations reprogramming and congressional oversight correspondence is expected volume for any large agency; density reflects the CIA Reading Room's completeness, not necessarily anomaly.
discriminating_next_step: Cross-check specific reprogramming amounts/dates against Federal Register and CourtListener (once keyed) for an independent second family; OCR the ingested PDFs to compare stated purposes across duplicate releases.

title: CIA Form 610 'Routing and Record Sheet' recurring internal-flow artifact (1952-1984)
ordinary_explanation: Routing and Record Sheets are a standard cover form on essentially every filed document; recurrence is structural, not anomalous, and is better used as a linkage key (who routed what to whom) than as a standalone signal.
discriminating_next_step: Treat routing sheets as network edges: extract originating/receiving offices to build an office-to-office graph rather than promoting the form itself.

title: Negative/disambiguation: 'reprogramming' does not bridge budget and DOE technical families
ordinary_explanation: The token 'reprogramming' is a homonym across domains; cross-family vocabulary transfer must be validated semantically, not lexically. Recorded so later rounds do not treat lexical overlap as a cross-source bridge.
discriminating_next_step: For any candidate cross-family term, confirm sense alignment before counting it as independence.
